name: engraphy
description: Engraphy — the memory engine for AI agents. Registers the Engraphy MCP server with VS Code, plus a branded confirm-write queue and memory explorer.

engraphy.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the Engraphy MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP). For a local bring-up this is `http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/`; for a hosted deployment point it at `/mcp/` behind your TLS proxy. **Keep the trailing slash** — the server 307-redirects `/mcp` → `/mcp/`, and the redirect round-trip adds ~10s of latency per call (the extension normalizes a missing slash for you, but the default is correct as shipped).

engraphy.token.markdownDescription: Bearer token for the Engraphy server. The token **is** your identity — it resolves to a (space, principal, role) on the server. Mint one with `engraphy-admin token create`. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

engraphy.space.markdownDescription: Optional label for the space this connection targets. **Informational only** — the actual space is determined by your `engraphy.token`. Used to label the server and the status bar.

engraphy.composeWorkingDirectory.markdownDescription: Working directory containing the Engraphy `compose.yaml` (and its `.env`). Used by **Engraphy: Start local server**. Defaults to the first workspace folder when empty.
